rows: Why use chiplets instead of one big die?
Yield: small dies yield much better; enables heterogeneous process nodes
Cache-coherent memory/device interconnect over PCIe 5.0 physical layer — enables memory pooling
Processing In Memory — puts compute near or inside DRAM to avoid data movement energy
What is the difference between TPU and GPU?
TPU: custom ASIC for matrix multiply, better TCO for ML; GPU: general compute with tensor cores
Event-driven (no idle compute), spike encoding, STDP learning — 1 mW vs 1 W at scale
Not for decades — RSA-2048 requires ~20M physical qubits; today's best: ~1000 low-quality qubits
What should you do about post-quantum crypto now?
Begin migration to NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) — don't wait for "harvest now, decrypt later"
